shared_training.initialization: network weights only from exp003 v123 epoch100; optimizer, momentum, scheduler, AMP scaler, and update count reset
shared_training.prompt_policy: multi-finding 2 positive + 1 negative; one-finding 1 positive + 2 negatives; every selected positive nonempty

native192_cont100.preprocessing: VoxTell orientation fix, crop-to-nonzero, full cropped-volume z-score once, native-resolution 192^3 positive crop

iso2mm_global192_cont100.preprocessing: same orientation/crop/z-score, then 2 mm isotropic trilinear align_corners=false without antialiasing; nearest-exact masks with foreground fallback
iso2mm_global192_cont100.padding: symmetric model padding with image 0.0 and mask 0
iso2mm_global192_cont100.validation: overlapping 192^3 sliding windows in 2 mm space; inverse trilinear probability restoration to native crop

differences_from_exp003_v123: Initialization is the exp003 v123 epoch100 network instead of VoxTell v1.1.
The optimizer and polynomial schedule restart for a fresh 100-epoch continuation.
The event stream uses deterministic events 10000-19999 instead of replaying events 0-9999.
The 2 mm arm adds post-normalization isotropic resampling and global-context sliding inference.
The native arm is otherwise the exp003 v123 recipe.
differences_from_voxtell_pretraining: ReX one-finding cases use 1 positive + 2 negatives.
Training is single-GPU batch1 for 100 fixed optimizer updates per epoch.
Fine-tuning uses low differential learning rates and the v123 empty-target/weighted-BCE loss.
The 2 mm arm changes physical sampling while retaining a 192^3 model tensor.
